world.title: ‘Biggest deal in history’: Trump says US to control 65 billion barrels of Venezuela oil
world.summary: US President Donald Trump announced an agreement with Venezuela that would grant the US control over 65 billion barrels of oil. This announcement follows discussions about reintroducing US oil companies to Venezuela after the removal of President Maduro. Trump characterized the deal as the "biggest deal in history," emphasizing its significance for US energy interests.

world.title: Who is Milo Yiannopoulos, far-right British commentator, detained by ICE? Former Trump supporter faces deportation
world.summary: British far-right commentator Milo Yiannopoulos, known for his support of former President Donald Trump, has been detained by U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) in Louisiana. He faces deportation to the United Kingdom. Yiannopoulos has been a controversial figure in political discourse, and his detention raises questions about immigration enforcement and the treatment of public figures in the U.S.

world.title: Venezuela Helped Build OPEC. Now It May Help Break It Apart
world.summary: Venezuela, a founding member of OPEC, is contemplating exiting the organization over six decades after its establishment. The potential departure comes amid changing geopolitical dynamics, with the United States seemingly supportive of Venezuela's decision. This shift could significantly impact OPEC's structure and influence in global oil markets, marking a notable transition for a country historically tied to the organization.

business.title: Tata Sons gets 3-month AGM extension relief after quorum issue
business.summary: Tata Sons has been granted a three-month extension for its annual general meeting due to quorum issues caused by restrictions on the Sir Ratan Tata Trust. This extension aims to safeguard the interests of minority shareholders during this period. The annual general meeting can be conducted earlier if the trust's restrictions are lifted before the extension period ends.

business.title: Ather Konarc Leaked Ahead of August 29 Launch - Production Scooter Revealed
business.summary: Ather Energy's upcoming electric scooter, the Ather Konarc, has been leaked ahead of its official launch on August 29, 2026. The leaked images showcase the production-ready model, revealing details about its design, expected range, touchscreen features, and variants. The Konarc is anticipated to utilize the EL platform, marking a significant addition to Ather's electric scooter lineup.

business.title: Jio Platforms gets Sebi nod for 37.7k cr IPO, set to be India's biggest
business.summary: Jio Platforms, the digital division of Reliance Industries led by Mukesh Ambani, has received approval from the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) for an initial public offering (IPO). The IPO is anticipated to raise approximately ₹37,700 crore (around $4 billion), positioning it to potentially become the largest IPO in India's history.

technology.title: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE in for review
technology.summary: Samsung is reviewing the Galaxy S26 FE, also referred to as the "Galaxy S26 AI" or "Galaxy S25 FE Part 2." The Galaxy FE models have garnered significant interest from dedicated Galaxy fans. However, there are concerns that Samsung may be releasing the S26 FE too close to previous models, potentially impacting its reception among consumers.

technology.title: Xbox CEO Says Project Helix Includes a 'Family of Devices'
technology.summary: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma announced that Project Helix will involve a "family of devices," indicating a broader scope than previously expected. During a BBC interview, Sharma hinted at upcoming developments related to the project, suggesting that Microsoft is focusing on creating multiple interconnected devices. Further details about the specific devices and features are yet to be revealed.

technology.title: Google Pixel Watch 5 Review: Long Live The King
technology.summary: The Google Pixel Watch 5 emphasizes simplicity and features a sleek dome design, continuing the legacy of its predecessors. It has garnered attention for its aesthetic appeal and functionality within the smart wearable market. The watch aims to meet user expectations with its design and performance, reinforcing its position as a top choice among smartwatches.

sports.title: Man City explore move Barcelona target Julian Alvarez as he trains by himself
sports.summary: FC Barcelona target Julian Alvarez has missed training with Atletico Madrid for three consecutive days. He returned to Cerro del Espino to train individually with a club fitness coach, ending his period of “indisposition.” Meanwhile, Manchester City is reportedly exploring a move for Alvarez, who remains a key target for Barcelona as the transfer window approaches.

sports.title: Asian Games facilities leave top teams uneasy
sports.summary: Concerns have arisen among continental cricket boards regarding the quality and readiness of facilities for the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026. Issues pertain to both the venue and accommodation. Members of the Asian Cricket Council, led by Pakistan’s Mohsin Naqvi, feel there may have been delays in addressing these problems, leading to unease among top teams ahead of the event.

sports.title: Robinson, Archer put England in command at Lord's
sports.summary: Ollie Robinson and Jofra Archer led England's bowling attack, taking seven wickets to dismiss Pakistan for 110 runs on Day 2 of the Lord’s Test. England, having scored 290 in their first innings, established a commanding 261-run lead by stumps. The performance put England in a strong position to secure victory in the ongoing match.

health.title: H1N1 cases climb in Jammu as seasonal flu activity rises nationwide, docs urge caution
health.summary: H1N1 influenza cases are increasing in Jammu, with 11 recorded in July and 25 so far in August at GMC-J. This rise has raised concerns about seasonal respiratory infections nationwide. Doctors are advising the public to remain cautious and vigilant as flu activity escalates, highlighting the importance of preventive measures during this period of heightened illness.

health.title: POET-II trial reduces antibiotic duration for infective endocarditis by two weeks
health.summary: The POET-II trial demonstrated that a response-tailored strategy can safely reduce the antibiotic treatment duration for patients with left-sided infective endocarditis by two weeks. This finding was presented during a Hot Line session at the ESC Congress. The study indicates that shorter antibiotic courses may be effective without compromising patient safety, marking a significant advancement in treatment protocols.

health.title: Physical Activity Linked to Lower Stroke Risk in Atrial Fibrillation
health.summary: A study published in August 2026 reveals that physical activity can significantly reduce the risk of stroke and premature death in individuals with atrial fibrillation (afib), a prevalent heart rhythm disorder. Even minimal exercise contributes to these health benefits, highlighting the importance of physical activity for those affected by afib in managing their overall health and wellbeing.

science.title: Insects Have Six Legs. But This 324-Million-Year-Old Insect Had 24 Legs and a Body Unlike Anything Alive Today
science.summary: A 324-million-year-old insect fossil, misidentified for decades as a baby crustacean, has been revealed to possess 24 legs, challenging the standard six-legged structure of modern insects. Discovered in West Texas, the flattened fossil was overlooked until paleoentomologist Erik Tihelka reexamined it. This finding provides insights into the evolutionary history of insects before their current anatomical form became established.

science.title: Researchers throw more light on 1.2bn-yr-old Mars meteorite
science.summary: Researchers have determined that a Martian meteorite discovered in Algeria is approximately 1.27 billion years old. This finding was made by a team from various institutions, including the Universities Space Research Association. In contrast, another Martian meteorite found in Northwest Africa, known as 7635, is believed to be around 2.5 billion years old, classified as a shergottite.

science.title: Engineered bacteria offer a new way to accelerate rock weathering for carbon removal
science.summary: Engineered bacteria have been developed to enhance rock weathering, a natural process that breaks down rocks and minerals through exposure to water, air, and biological activity. This process plays a crucial role in regulating atmospheric CO2 levels and climate. Historically, rock weathering has accelerated during warmer periods with higher CO2 concentrations, highlighting its significance in carbon removal efforts.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Today: August 29, 2026
entertainment.summary: On August 29, 2026, Aries may feel overwhelmed by hidden issues affecting their well-being. After investing significant effort into their projects, fatigue has set in, indicating a need for rest. The horoscope suggests that taking a break could be beneficial to recharge and address underlying concerns. Prioritizing self-care is essential for maintaining balance and mental health.

entertainment.title: Gemini Horoscope Today: August 29, 2026
entertainment.summary: On August 29, 2026, Gemini individuals are encouraged to seek guidance from a higher force. The younger aspect of themselves, once in need of support and healing, is now experiencing pride in personal growth. This transformation reflects a shift from merely pursuing life to embracing a more balanced and reflective approach, highlighting the importance of self-care and emotional development.

entertainment.summary: Aquarius individuals are entering a new, flourishing period in their lives, leaving the past behind. While they may still have their guard up, they are beginning to embrace positive changes. Although they are not yet living the life they desire, the stars indicate a promising outlook.
